description: AIOS maturity assessment rubric — how to score each layer and determine overall maturity

bands.1-3: Minimal or absent — this layer barely exists
bands.4-6: Developing — elements present but not systematic
bands.7-10: Mature — this layer is well-built and actively maintained

positive: Uses modern SaaS tools with REST APIs
Tools chosen partly for integration capability
negative: Using free tiers that limit API access

positive: MCP servers connected to Claude Code
Data syncs automatically between CRM and billing
Claude Code installed and used regularly
Team members comfortable with AI tools
negative: AI used only for ad-hoc chatting
Fear or resistance to AI adoption

positive: AI can query business data directly
Team uses slash commands for processes
AIOS health visible at a glance
Single pane of glass for operations
negative: No unified view of business state

key_actions: Connect 2-3 core tools via MCP or Zapier
Install Claude Code and run first automation
Set up one webhook for real-time data sync
quick_wins: Connect CRM to email via MCP
Automate invoice creation from CRM deals
Set up Slack/Teams notifications for key events

key_actions: Build 3-5 core Claude Code skills for daily processes
Create CLAUDE.md with business identity and rules
Set up client memory files for top 10 clients
Centralize key data in a queryable format
quick_wins: Write initial CLAUDE.md with brand voice
Set up client context files for active clients

key_actions: Rich Context OS with deep client memory
quick_wins: Create skills for all recurring weekly tasks
Enrich Context OS with decision frameworks

gap_templates.no_connections: Your tools are disconnected — data isn't flowing between systems automatically
gap_templates.no_intelligence: No AI intelligence layer in place — Claude Code or equivalent not yet adopted
gap_templates.no_data_os: Business data is scattered — no centralized data layer for AI to query
gap_templates.no_skills: No custom skills or automated workflows — all processes are manual
gap_templates.no_context_os: No Context OS — AI doesn't know your business identity, rules, or preferences
gap_templates.no_dashboard: No unified dashboard — business state requires checking multiple tools
gap_templates.weak_stack_apis: Current tools have limited API access — this constrains what can be connected
gap_templates.no_mcp: No MCP connections — missing the fastest path to tool integration with Claude
